card.name: Verbs of emotional reaction
card.fires_on: Verbs or verb stems describing a mental or emotional reaction, such as puzzled, tired of, panicked, anguished, overjoyed, shocking. It fires just before the sentence says what the person reacted to.

modes.label: Reaction verb after subject
modes.description: A past-tense verb of feeling or puzzlement right after a person or group as subject.
modes.example: Researchers have<< puzzled>> for decades over why women in Asia tend

modes.label: Partway through emotion words
modes.description: The inside of a longer emotion word, such as panicked, anguished or overjoyed.
modes.example: The Parisian government pan<<iced>> when the emerging Paris Commune killed military

modes.label: Idiom of reacting
modes.description: Verbs inside set phrases about noticing or being baffled.
modes.example: the latter of which has specialists<< scratching>> their heads as

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word toward a Chinese-style phrase about being affected or reacting, and away from words meaning attract or move someone.
card.plain: It marks a verb that says someone reacted emotionally or mentally to something.
